verdicts.correction: FrontierCode Main, Opus 5.5 by effort (read from Figure 8.3.A): approximately 47.2% at about 9K output tokens (low), 54.6% at about 18.5K (medium), 53.9% at about 26K (high), 51.4% at about 60K (xhigh), and approximately 54.4% at about 165K (max). It is the top series at medium, high and max only: at low Fable 5.1 (about 49.8%) is above Opus 5.5 (about 47.2%), and at xhigh Sonnet 5.5 (52.1%) is above Opus 5.5 (about 51.4%).
verdicts.why: The five point values are right, but 'top series at every effort level' is false on the same chart (Fable 5.1 low and Sonnet 5.5 xhigh are higher).

verdicts.correction: Haiku 5.5 trails Sonnet 5.5 by 31.4 points (39.2% vs 70.6%) and Opus 5.5 by 27.2 points (39.2% vs 66.4%, Opus at xhigh) on Terminal-Bench 4.0; the largest Haiku-to-Sonnet gap in pages 111-117 is on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 (20.6% vs 59.9%, 39.3 points, page 116), not Terminal-Bench 4.0.
verdicts.why: The subtraction is right but the superlative is wrong: the Terminal-Bench-Science gap on page 116 (39.3 points) is larger than 31.4.

verdicts.correction: HLE no tools: Haiku 5.5 at low effort (30.9%) sits at about $0.0034 per task on the chart, roughly one-third of the charted cost of Haiku 4.5 at its 4K budget (5.8% at about $0.010) and below every Haiku 4.5 point (about $0.010 to $0.094); costs are read from the log axis.
verdicts.why: 'About the same as or less' understates the chart; the two points are about a factor of three apart on the log axis.

verdicts.correction: WANDR: Haiku 5.5 at high (37.3%, about $1.5 per task) scores above Sonnet 5.5 at medium (29.9%, about $0.82) and Opus 5.5 at low (31.2%, about $1.2). The Sonnet 5.5 line passes through Haiku 5.5's high point and is above the Haiku 5.5 line from about $1.5 per task; the Opus 5.5 line stays below the Haiku 5.5 line until about $3 per task (near Haiku 5.5's xhigh point, 45.9% at about $3.6) and is above it after that. All costs are approximate chart readings.
verdicts.why: The single $2 crossover is a misread: Sonnet 5.5 crosses at about $1.5 and Opus 5.5 not until about $3.

verdicts.correction: BenchCAD with tools comparators (read from Figure 8.9.2.B): Sonnet 5.5 rises from approximately 0.33 at about $0.004 per task to 0.963 at about $4.7; Opus 5.5 from approximately 0.40 at about $0.009 to 0.962 at about $6. The Haiku 5.5 with-tools line is above both from its start to roughly $1.2 per task; the Sonnet 5.5 line crosses it just before Haiku 5.5's max point (0.870 at about $1.65, where the Sonnet 5.5 line reads about 0.88), while the Opus 5.5 line is about equal to Haiku 5.5 there (about 0.86 to 0.87).
verdicts.why: At Haiku 5.5's max point the Sonnet 5.5 line is marginally above it, so 'at or above both up to its max point' is slightly too strong.
